campaign_inputs.run2024i_policy: Use the standard MINIv6NANOv15 production; exclude the alternate MINIv6NANOv15_v2 production to prevent duplicate event coverage.
campaign_inputs.mc_campaign_note: Use the single 52-file Summer24 SPS-JpsiJpsiToMuMuEE dataset, which contains a J/psi-to-electron leg and supplies full-detector probe statistics. Keep the two-file Winter24 inclusive JpsiToEE sample only as a closure sample, never mixed without normalization.

binning_policy: The original 4x5 counting grid is exactly merged after reduction to three eta bins covering 5--10 GeV. Pre-adoption studies found no statistically resolved pT dependence but large model uncertainty in subdivided endcap pT bins; the adopted binning retains eta dependence while requiring stable J/psi signal fits without re-reading events.
eta_policy: Exclude the 1.4442--1.566 ECAL transition; the adjacent endcap bin is populated only for abs(eta)>1.566.
denominator: reconstructed GSF electron with 5 < pT < 10 GeV passing the ECAL fiducial region, conversion veto, and lostHits <= 1, but not the target cutBased/mini-isolation selection
tag: tight high-purity electron matched to the reference trigger object
trigger_object_bit_source: 2024 data/MC NanoAOD audit: electron trigger-object bit 13 is populated for the unrestricted Ele8/Ele12 plus PFJet30 reference paths
reference_trigger_strategy: Use a single-electron tag path without an eta1p22 probe restriction. The PFJet30 leg is event-side and is not part of the probe pass/fail definition; its residual topology dependence is checked in closure.
adoption_gates: simultaneous pass/fail fit convergence in every adopted bin
bin-by-bin scale-factor stability under fit-model, fit-window, binning, and pileup variations
